thread:
oncall-bot: URGENT: paging — high error rate detected on frontend-gateway (5xx spike). PagerDuty alert: P0. See grafana: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/fgw/fgw-5xx-spike

kai (eng-sre): acked, oncall here. Looking at grafana now. ETA 5m.

anya (eng-runtime): i see a huge jump starting ~2219876400, requests returning 502/503/504 from gateway. Backend p99 latency is OK. Looks like failures are at gateway layer.

liam (infra): I'm pulling envoy logs from the gateway cluster. Running:
```
kubectl -n infra logs deploy/frontend-gateway --since=10m | grep 'upstream reset\|503\|no healthy upstream'
```
Got a lot of: `upstream connect error or disconnect/reset before headers. reset reason: connection failure`

kai (eng-sre): Can you paste a few sample lines?

liam (infra): pasted: `2026-03-15T10:34:12.123Z envoy warning upstream reset: cluster: backend-embeders, reason: CONNECTION_FAILURE, response_code: 503`
`2026-03-15T10:34:14.456Z envoy error no healthy upstream for route /v1/generate`

anya (eng-runtime): hmm "no healthy upstream" usually shows the route pointed at a cluster that has been removed or a weight set to 0. Did a route rollout go out?

sre-rotation: I saw a canary earlier this morning from infra:router-team trying to tweak retries/circuit_breakers for route /v1/generate.

kai (eng-sre): Paging infra@router-team. @liam can you dump the active route config?

liam (infra): `kubectl -n infra exec -it gateway-0 -- curl -s http://127.0.0.1:9901/config_dump > /tmp/gw-config.json`
Snippet: `"routes": [{"prefix": "/v1/generate","cluster": "backend-embeders-v2","priority": "HIGH","retry_policy": {"num_retries": 5},"weighted_clusters": {"clusters": [{"name":"backend-embeders-v2","weight":0}]}}]`

mira (product): wait weight 0? that sounds like the canary set weight=0 by mistake. That would route to no cluster and trigger 503s.

anya (eng-runtime): yep that matches the 503/no healthy upstream. The route now points to a cluster with zero weight and no fallback cluster.

kai (eng-sre): OK mitigation plan: 1) set weighted cluster weight back to 100 for backend-embeders-v2, 2) temporarily disable retries at gateway to avoid retry amplification, 3) watch error rate. Who can apply?

liam (infra): I can apply a hotfix via adhoc rollout. Running patch now: `kubectl -n infra patch configmap gateway-routes --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/data/routes.json","value":"...updated with weight 100..."}]'`

support-bot: Customer impact: 12k failed requests in the last 10m (approx 8% global traffic). Regions: us-west-2 ~60%, eu-central ~25%, ap-southeast ~15%. Severity: customer-facing failures for text generation endpoints. Ticketing: creating support incidents for top 5 customers.

liam (infra): applied patch at 2219876645. Restarting gateway pods gracefully.

kai (eng-sre): disabled retries with `envoyctl set-config --route /v1/generate --unset-retry` and set circuit_breakers to default higher thresholds to avoid immediate droppings.

anya (eng-runtime): running smoke: `curl -i https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' -d '{"prompt": "hello"}'`
Before fix: `HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable`
After fix: `HTTP/1.1 200 OK` — getting valid responses now.

mira (product): support — please send an incident status update to affected customers: short note that we had a gateway routing regression, services restored, we will follow up with root cause and timeline.

support-bot: drafting messages. ETA 10m.

kai (eng-sre): Monitoring: grafana shows error rate falling back to baseline by 2219876720. p95 latency stable. Will keep eyes on it for 30m.

liam (infra): Confirmed no longer seeing `no healthy upstream` logs. Envoy config now shows weight 100 for backend-embeders-v2 and a fallback cluster configured.

sre-rotation: handing off to next oncall in 10m. I'm adding runbook notes: cause = bad canary that set weighted cluster weight to 0; mitigation = rollback to previous route weights, disable retries temporarily, increase circuit breaker thresholds, restart pods gracefully.

kai (eng-sre): action items assigned: infra/router-team to revert canary rollout + add guard in rollout job to prevent weight 0 without explicit fallback (owner: liam). runtime to add validation that route with 0-weight must have fallback cluster (owner: anya). SRE to run postmortem (owner: kai).

mira (product): please include estimated customer impact metrics and timeline in postmortem. Also include list of customers contacted.

support-bot: Created support tickets: #INC-4721, #INC-4722, #INC-4723 for top customers. Messages queued.

kai (eng-sre): final status: service restored at 2219876645, error budget impact ~8% errors over 10m window. Postmortem and timeline in a follow-up. Marking this thread resolved but will leave pinned for the postmortem. :white_check_mark:

sre-rotation: Oncall handoff completed to next oncall @sre-rotation-next.

mira (product): thanks team.

kai (eng-sre): closing thread but will link to postmortem doc when available.
